questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words. He studies the subject known as the scientific study of insects.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

He studies the subject known as the scientific study of insects.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Entomology.

Key Points

  • "Entomology" is the branch of zoology concerned with the study of insects. It involves researching their development, anatomy, physiology, behavior, distribution, ecology, and classification. (कीट विज्ञान)
    • Example: Entomologists may study the role of insects in spreading diseases or their importance in pollination.
  • Hence, the scientific study of insects is known as 'Entomology'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Entomology.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Alchemy (रसायन विद्या): An early form of chemistry, with philosophic and magical associations, aimed at the transmutation of base metals into gold, the discovery of a universal cure for disease, and the discovery of a means of indefinitely prolonging life.
    • Example: Alchemy is often considered the precursor to the modern science of chemistry.
  • Etymology (शब्द उत्पत्ति विज्ञान): The study of the origin of words and the way in which their meanings have changed throughout history.
    • Example: Understanding the etymology of words can provide insight into the history and evolution of a language.
  • The subject "Biology" is a natural science concerned with the study of life and living organisms, including their structure, function, growth, evolution, distribution, and taxonomy. (जीव विज्ञान)
    • Example: Studying biology helps us understand the living world and the ways its many species (including humans) function, evolve, and interact.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the underlined group of words. Kidney beans were boiled quickly when Nisha added a substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed by the reaction itself .
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the underlined group of words.

Kidney beans were boiled quickly when Nisha added a substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed by the reaction itself.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Catalyst.

Key Points

  • The word "Reactant" refers to a substance that takes part in and undergoes change during a reaction. (प्रतिक्रियाशील पदार्थ)
    • Example: Water is a reactant when it reacts with sodium to produce sodium hydroxide and hydrogen gas.
  • "Catalyst" is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change; it is critical for processes that require a lower activation energy. (उत्प्रेरक)
    • Example: Enzymes are biological catalysts that accelerate reactions in the human body.
  • "Enzyme" is a type of protein that acts as a catalyst in living organisms, speeding up specific biochemical reactions. (एंजाइम)
    • Example: The enzyme amylase helps in the breakdown of starch into sugars in the digestive system.
  • "Solute" is a substance dissolved in another substance, known as the solvent, to form a solution. (विलेय)
    • Example: Salt is a solute that dissolves in water, the solvent, to form a saline solution.
  • Hence, we can infer that the substance that speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed by the reaction itself is known as a 'Catalyst'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Catalyst.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Reactant (प्रतिक्रियाशील पदार्थ): A substance participating in a chemical reaction.
    • Example: In the reaction between vinegar and baking soda, both are reactants that produce carbon dioxide.
  • Enzyme (एंजाइम): Biological molecules that significantly speed up the rate of virtually all of the chemical reactions that take place within cells.
    • Example: Lactase is an enzyme that helps digest lactose, the sugar in milk.
  • Solute (विलेय): A substance dissolved in another substance, forming a solution.
    • Example: When sugar is added to water, sugar acts as the solute.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:
